verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a migration guide for importing from other databases/services (Auth0, Firebase, Heroku, RDS, Postgres, Neon, etc.) and provides read replicas and backups, but there's no explicit documented technique for zero/minimal-downtime cutover (e.g., logical replication, dual-write strategy) for an existing production database. Community feedback also flags the broader migration/schema workflow as a known weak spot, suggesting the path isn't as smooth as documented. Missing for 10: explicit minimal-downtime migration tooling/guide, benchmarked downtime figures, and independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth production cutover.
